vibe: Dark premium 'intelligence dossier' aesthetic, enterprise operations, trust, security, scale.

headings.usage: Use for bold kinetic headings with tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em).

mono_accents.usage: Use for overlines, labels, technical data, and manifesto chapter numbers (tracking wide: 0.1em).

colors.instructions: No standard full-screen gradients. Use solid near-blacks with 1px subtle borders. Only use accent_signal for tactical 'live' data indicators or warning/error states.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise overlay (SVG filter) on dark surfaces to create a premium, tactile 'dossier' feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08) everywhere to expose the grid skeleton (Grid Borders pattern). 'Tracing Beam' (Aceternity style) glow on key pricing/feature cards.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for floating sticky nav and context menus (backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-black/60, border-b border-white/10).

grids_layouts.marketing_grid: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris). Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12), extreme asymmetry. Never fill 100% perfectly; leave negative space.
grids_layouts.data_grid: High density, strict alignment, monospace numbers for feature matrices.
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous padding. Use py-24 to py-32 for main sections. Allow elements to breathe.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY for a premium weighty momentum.
motion.hero: Framer Motion line-by-line masked kinetic reveal for the main H1.
motion.marquee: Extremely slow editorial marquee for the 7 positioning pillars, using JetBrains Mono or a stark Serif.
motion.reveal: Subtle y-axis (+20px) and opacity reveal on scroll for all sections.

components.buttons: Sharp rectangular or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast (e.g., bg-white text-black for primary CTA). Micro-interactions on hover (scale 0.98).
components.cards: Flat background (#0C0C0F), 1px subtle border, no shadow unless elevated. Add an inner 1px border of white/5 for crispness.
components.accordions: Shadcn accordion, heavily customized. Strip default borders. Use JetBrains Mono for numbering each item.

three_d_libraries.usage: Implement a 3D data-network visual in the Hero background. A subtle, floating particle node network or abstract globe indicating 'Enterprise CRM Network'. Must be dark, tactical, with glowing white/gray nodes and subtle red signal flashes. Wrap in <Suspense>.

hero_fallback.description: Dark blue abstract data network lines, use as fallback if 3D fails or for feature backgrounds.

enterprise_security.description: Dark computer monitor coding/security, useful for the 'Enterprise Security' section.

corporate_office.description: City skyline at dusk enterprise dark, perfect for 'Industries' or 'About' page headers.

conference_room.description: Modern corporate conference room, use for 'Solutions' or 'Contact' pages.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Lenis (@studio-freight/lenis) for smooth scrolling.
Implement the hero section with Framer Motion for line-by-line text reveal, and React Three Fiber for the 3D data network background.
Use JetBrains Mono for structural UI elements (manifesto chapters, overlines, metadata, step numbers).
Build the 'Manifesto Chapters' section using a numbered scroll-spy, sticky card stacking effect, or horizontal scroll section.
Create a slow 'Editorial Marquee' displaying the 7 positioning pillars (Enterprise CRM First, AI Enabled, Unlimited Users, etc.).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
NEVER use generic placeholder images; use the provided image_urls.
Avoid the default 'Vercel-look'. Customize Shadcn components aggressively with the deep black/slate colors.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical 'Tetris' grid layouts with wide gaps.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition like 'transition: all'. Explicitly transition specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles, high contrast.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭). Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (py-24, py-32).
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components, but customize them heavily.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text. Use text shadow over images.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus states, higher contrast than default state. E.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white.

testing.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
